diagram_previews.alt: Two intersecting circles with centres O1 (left, larger) and O2 (right) meeting at A. M is the midpoint of the dashed segment O1O2, and the blue dashed segment AM is perpendicular to the red line through A, which meets the first circle again at B and the second at C. Dotted perpendiculars from O1 and O2 meet the line at F1 and F2 with right-angle marks, and the four segments BF1, F1A, AF2 and F2C carry equal tick marks.

difficulty_rationale: An unstated approach requiring some exploration and a few connected steps.
